as_told.title: Virgin Mary appears in dream and then in Paris hotel room, tells him to write to the Pope

plain: Rolf Mowatt-Larssen, who goes by Ralph, is a former officer of the CIA, the US spy agency. On the podcast of host Jesse Michels, he says that in 1998 he was in Paris on a CIA work trip, dealing with Russian matters. He says a dream came first. Then, standing in the room, he saw the full image of the Virgin Mary right across from him, floating above the floor. According to Ralph, Mary told him to write to the Pope. Later in the same interview he adds something he says he forgot at first: at the end of the experience, she told him, "We will meet again." He also mentions Thomas Merton, an American Catholic monk and writer. If true, it would mean a senior intelligence officer had a religious vision in the middle of his spy work. All the tellings are Ralph's own, given at different points in one conversation, each adding details.
